title: Latency Horizon panel: unified p50/p95/p99 + streaming vs non-streaming breakdowns by model & route
creator: Maya Lopez
description: Goal: Build a single 'Latency Horizon' dashboard panel that gives SREs and platform engineers an immediate view of tail and median latency (p50/p95/p99) broken down by model, route, and IO mode (streaming vs non-streaming). The panel should support both real-time (1m/5m) and post-hoc (1h/24h) aggregation windows, show distribution histograms, and link directly to traces and relevant logs for root-cause. This ticket covers the queries, aggregation layer changes, trace-linking UI hook, and dashboard UX for one reusable panel component that can be embedded across Console dashboards.
acceptance_criteria: Panel exposes p50, p95, p99 percentiles for selected time window and granularity
Panel supports explicit breakdown: streaming vs non-streaming IO mode (binary toggle) and shows both stacked and side-by-side visualizations
Model and route filters are available; model-version dropdown included (supports wildcard 'all')
Each latency bucket point links to the representative trace in tracing UI with prepopulated trace filters (model, route, io_mode, time window)
Histogram view for request-size/request-shape cohorts with ability to pivot from percentile line to cohort histogram
Panel refreshes without full page reload and respects data retention guardrails; uses streaming metrics pipeline for near-realtime 1m buckets and metrics pipeline for 1h rollups
Automated smoke tests assert panel queries return within expected runtime thresholds in staging (<= 800ms for dashboard API responses)
Documentation (Confluence) and dashboard help text added explaining interpretation and known caveats (quantization from downstream rollups)
Optional: alert snippet generator that creates an SLO alert for any model/route p99 spike exceeding baseline + X%
